name: MonarchAreaChart
title: AreaChart
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas through the MonarchLineChart core (its plot area, drawing, axis, inspection row and TalkBack elements) with pointerInput tap and horizontal drag gestures; the stack computed by Monarch; inside MonarchChartFrame with MonarchChartLegend (square markers) and MonarchChartTable
summary: An area chart for volumes over ordered categories or dates: several series overlapping, stacked so the top edge is the total, or stacked to 100% to show shares, with touch inspection, legend toggles and a data table.
whenToUse: To show a total over time made of parts (traffic by platform, revenue by plan) with Stacked, how the mix changes when the total does not matter with Expand, or one or two volumes where the filled area helps read magnitude with Overlap.
whenNotToUse: To compare trends of independent measures, use MonarchLineChart: overlapping fills hide each other beyond two series. For values that go negative, use MonarchBarChart. For parts of one whole at a single moment, use MonarchDonutChart or MonarchStackedProportionBar.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAreaChart(title: String, categories: List<String>, series: List<MonarchLineChartSeries>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, xTitle: String? = null, summary: String? = null, stacking: MonarchAreaChartStacking = MonarchAreaChartStacking.Overlap, curve: MonarchLineChartCurve = MonarchLineChartCurve.Linear, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = MonarchChartFrameStatus.Ready, hiddenSeries: Set<String>? = null, onHiddenSeriesChange: ((Set<String>) -> Unit)? = null, activeIndex: Int? = null, onActiveIndexChange: ((Int?) -> Unit)? = null, referenceLines: List<MonarchLineChartReferenceLine> = emptyList(), valueRange: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Double>? = null, includeZero: Boolean = true, legendToggle: Boolean = true, tableToggle: Boolean = true, emptyMessage: String? = null, footer: String? = null, height: Dp? = null, labels: MonarchAreaChartLabels = MonarchAreaChartLabels(), formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onSelect: ((Int) -> Unit)? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchAreaChart(title: String, dates: List<Long>, series: List<MonarchLineChartSeries>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, xTitle: String? = null, summary: String? = null, stacking: MonarchAreaChartStacking = MonarchAreaChartStacking.Overlap, curve: MonarchLineChartCurve = MonarchLineChartCurve.Linear, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = MonarchChartFrameStatus.Ready, hiddenSeries: Set<String>? = null, onHiddenSeriesChange: ((Set<String>) -> Unit)? = null, activeIndex: Int? = null, onActiveIndexChange: ((Int?) -> Unit)? = null, referenceLines: List<MonarchLineChartReferenceLine> = emptyList(), valueRange: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Double>? = null, includeZero: Boolean = true, legendToggle: Boolean = true, tableToggle: Boolean = true, emptyMessage: String? = null, footer: String? = null, height: Dp? = null, labels: MonarchAreaChartLabels = MonarchAreaChartLabels(), formatDate: ((Long) -> String)? = null, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onSelect: ((Int) -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchAreaChartStacking { Overlap, Stacked, Expand }

class MonarchAreaChartLabels(frame: MonarchChartFrameLabels = MonarchChartFrameLabels(), category: String? = null, date: String? = null, noData: String? = null, details: String? = null, clearSelection: String? = null, total: String? = null, share: ((value: String, share: String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The chart's name: the frame heading and the plot's spoken name.

options.name: categories
options.description: The x values in order, already localised. Spaced evenly.

options.name: dates
options.description: The x values in order as epoch milliseconds (UTC). Spaced by time.

options.name: series
options.description: The measures, bottom of the stack first: key, label, one value per x value (null or not finite is a gap), optional color slot and dashed. The MonarchLineChart type.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the frame.

options.name: description
options.description: One line under the title.

options.name: xTitle
options.description: The heading of the x column of the data table. Built in: "Category" or "Date".

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated spoken summary of the plot.

options.name: stacking
options.description: Overlap: each area from the baseline; Stacked: piled so the top edge is the total; Expand: piled as shares of 100%.

options.name: curve
options.description: Linear, or Monotone: smooth edges that never overshoot.

options.name: status
options.description: Ready, loading, empty or error, drawn by the frame. Ready with no x values or no series is empty.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: The keys of the hidden series. null lets the chart keep its own set, changed by the legend.

options.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
options.description: Called with the new hidden set when the legend changes it.

options.name: activeIndex
options.description: The inspected x value, used when onActiveIndexChange is set, to share a crosshair between charts.

options.name: onActiveIndexChange
options.description: Makes the inspection controlled: called with the inspected index, or null when cleared.

options.name: referenceLines
options.description: Dashed lines with a label and value. Not drawn or read in Expand, whose axis is shares.

options.name: valueRange
options.description: Fixes the value axis. Ignored in Expand, which is always 0 to 100%.

options.name: includeZero
options.description: Whether the value axis keeps zero when the areas overlap. Stacks always start at zero.

options.name: legendToggle
options.description: Whether legend entries show and hide their series. The legend shows for two or more series and keeps one visible.

options.name: tableToggle
options.description: Whether "View as table" is offered.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The empty-state message.

options.name: footer
options.description: Notes under the chart.

options.name: height
options.description: The plot height, kept in every status; 240dp by default.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the frame's, "Total" and the "820 (45%)" share text.

options.name: formatDate
options.description: Dates overload: writes a date everywhere. Default: abbreviated month and day in the current locale, in UTC.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes values in the inspection row, TalkBack, the table, the summary and on the axis. Default: numbers in the current locale, compact on the axis. Shares and the Expand axis are percentages in the locale.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error status.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Drill-in: called with the x index from Details in the inspection row or from the TalkBack action of that x value.

states.name: overlap
states.description: Each shown series is a fill from the baseline (zero, or the bottom of the axis without includeZero) with its top line drawn over every fill.

states.name: stacked
states.description: Series pile up in order, the first at the bottom; the top edge of the last is the total. Bands are a stronger shade because they touch. A negative value counts as zero in the stack.

states.name: expand
states.description: Series pile up as shares of each x value's total; the axis reads 0% to 100% and reference lines are not drawn or read. An x value whose total is zero has every share at zero.

states.name: inspecting
states.description: After a tap or drag, or with activeIndex: a crosshair, dots on the top edges and a row under the plot with each real value (with its share in Expand) and the total of a stack of two or more, with Details and Clear.

states.name: series hidden
states.description: The series leaves the plot and the stack; its legend entry shows Hidden; it stays in the data table and the table's total.

states.name: gap
states.description: A missing value breaks that series' band; in a stack the series above keep their place. A lone value between gaps is a dot.

states.name: loading, empty, error
states.description: Drawn by MonarchChartFrame at the chart's height.

appearance: Top lines are 2dp in the theme's data colors 1 to 5 in series order (Neutral in the subtle text color), dashed series dashed. Fills are opaque mixes of the series color towards the surface color: 80% when the areas overlap (90% for a dashed series), 60% for stacked bands. Gridlines, axis labels, reference lines and the crosshair are the line chart's roles. Every color is a theme role or a mix of two roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes are covered.
platformNotes: Drawn with a Compose Canvas through the MonarchLineChart core (iOS uses Swift Charts, the web SVG); Android has no first-party chart library and Monarch adds none. The stack is computed by Monarch, as on the web and iOS, so gaps break a band and negatives count as zero. Fills are opaque, never translucent as on the web: overlapping fills cover each other, so every top line is drawn over the fills; a stack is painted from the top band down, each fill reaching the baseline. Series, reference lines and the curve reuse the MonarchLineChart types. Names follow the Android MonarchLineChart (valueRange, includeZero, legendToggle, hiddenSeries with onHiddenSeriesChange) where iOS has valueDomain, includesZero, isLegendInteractive and Bindings; totalLabel and shareLabel are the total and share fields of MonarchAreaChartLabels. Unlike iOS, Android keeps the inspected x value after the finger lifts, shows it in a row under the plot with a polite live region, gives one TalkBack element per x value and a spoken summary, and offers onSelect drill-in, as MonarchLineChart does. The web's valueFormat, formatTick and numeric x values are not offered.
accessibility: The frame's title is a heading; the plot is one TalkBack element named by the title (role Image) whose state is the summary: the number and range of x values, each shown series' low, high and latest real value, the total of a stack of two or more, and the reference lines.

After the plot come one element per x value, in order and mirrored in right to left, read as the x value, each shown series' real value ("No value" for a gap, the share in Expand) and the total: "Mon: Web 420, iOS 210, Total 630".
With onSelect each x value has a "Details, Mon" TalkBack action; the inspection row's Details and Clear buttons have 48dp targets.
The inspection row is a polite live region, so the values are announced when the inspected x value changes.
"View as table" shows every series with real values and, in a stack of two or more, the total.
Series differ by name in the legend and every text alternative and, where dashed, by a dashed line and an outlined marker, never by color alone.
edgeCases: Missing, null and non-finite values are gaps, never zero; values beyond the x values are ignored.
In Stacked and Expand a negative value counts as zero in the stack; TalkBack, the inspection row and the table still give the real value.
Hiding series changes the stack and the shares but not the table's total, which sums every series.
A single series has no legend and no total.
A ready chart with no x values or no series shows the empty state.
Overlapping opaque fills cover each other; with more than two overlapping series prefer Stacked or MonarchLineChart.

examples.title: Shares of 100%
examples.code:
MonarchAreaChart(
    title = "Share of sessions",
    categories = listOf("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"),
    series = listOf(
        MonarchLineChartSeries("free", "Free", listOf(600.0, 580.0, 540.0, 500.0)),
        MonarchLineChartSeries("paid", "Paid", listOf(200.0, 260.0, 330.0, 410.0)),
    ),
    stacking = MonarchAreaChartStacking.Expand,
)

examples.title: One volume over dates with a goal
examples.code:
MonarchAreaChart(
    title = "Users",
    dates = listOf(1_772_323_200_000L, 1_775_001_600_000L, 1_777_593_600_000L),
    series = listOf(MonarchLineChartSeries("users", "Users", listOf(1_000.0, 1_085.0, 1_170.0))),
    curve = MonarchLineChartCurve.Monotone,
    activeIndex = inspected,
    onActiveIndexChange = { inspected = it },
    referenceLines = listOf(MonarchLineChartReferenceLine(1_200.0, "Goal")),
    height = 180.dp,
)

parityExceptions.reason: The axis labels are drawn on the chart canvas, where the preview shows them, and are not separate nodes for TalkBack; the chart carries one description and a View as table button that give every value.
parityExceptions.convention: chart axes are canvas drawing with a summary description and a table alternative (Material charts guidance)
